note: The four factions of Phase 1. Starting power and mood are invention (rules v2). The factions themselves are history; each one's facts cite docs/research/cast-405-395.md. 'leader' is who leads at the start.

factions.name: The common citizens
factions.note: A game grouping of the Syracusan demos.
factions.wants: Grain, a voice in the assembly and no tyrant.

goals.text: a share of the land being given out
a law that serves the people

facts.text: The assembly made Dionysius sole general.
facts.quote: to appoint him general with supreme power

facts.text: They were given houses, but not on the Island.
facts.quote: distributed the dwellings among the common people, except those on the island

facts.text: Later disarmed while out at the harvest.
facts.quote: carried off the arms of them all

factions.name: The rich families
factions.note: Crippled by the exile of the cavalry to Aetna (Diodorus 13.113.3).
factions.wants: Their land and silver safe, and office for their own men.

goals.text: terms for the exiles at Aetna
an office for one of their own
a marriage into the ruler's house

facts.text: Dionysius won power by attacking them.
facts.quote: presenting them as friends of oligarchy
the most respectable citizens suspected what was taking place

facts.text: Their cavalry hold Aetna in exile.
facts.quote: fled from the city and occupied Aetnê

factions.name: The mercenary guard
factions.note: The ruler's hired bodyguard (Diodorus 13.95.5 gives six hundred at first).
factions.wants: Pay, land, and to be needed.

facts.text: Began as a bodyguard of six hundred.
facts.quote: a guard of six hundred soldiers
which he gave to his friends and the mercenaries

facts.text: Turned hostile by about 396 and were paid in land.
facts.quote: seeing that the mercenaries were most hostile to him

factions.name: The ruler's family
factions.wants: A share in power, and to be named the heir.

goals.text: a good marriage for the house

facts.text: Marriages bound a great house to the tyranny.
facts.quote: to draw a distinguished house into relationship with him in order to make firm the tyranny

facts.text: Brothers, in-laws and friends sat on his war council.
facts.quote: gathered together his friends to counsel with them on the situation
